name: task-operations
description: Reusable operations pack for turning incoming work into executable task cards and maintaining deterministic shared and per-owner queues.

interface.shortDescription: Create, assign, and rank executable tasks.
interface.longDescription: Turns raw requests into consistent task cards, verifies readiness and role assignments, and maintains deterministic global and per-owner execution order without losing completion history.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create these tasks, assign the required fields, verify readiness, and update the execution order.
